newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo bourse says seeks to list Konaka.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo bourse says seeks to list Konaka.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Tuesday that it had applied to the Finance Ministry for permission to list shares of Konaka Co Ltd.
The shares are likely to be listed on July 18, the exchange said.

It added that Konaka, an operator of men's apparel chain stores now traded on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, plans to issue 500,000 new shares and to sell another one million previously issued shares at the time of its listing on the TSE.
